verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੋ ਸੁਅੰਨਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਾਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਵੈਸੋ ਈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: aapano sua(n)n jaise laagat piaaro jeea jaaneeaai vaiso iee piaaro sakal sa(n)saar kau ||

en.bdb: Just as one loves one's son by heart, so are their sons loved by all others in the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੋ ਦਰਬੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਵੈਸੋ ਈ ਸਮਝਿ ਸਭ ਕਾਹੰੂ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: aapano dharab jaise raakheeaai jatan kar vaiso iee samajh sabh kaaha(n)oo ke biauhaar kau ||

en.bdb: Just as one takes full care of one's wealth and assets, so should one treat other's business and profession monetarily.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਤੁਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਵੈਸੀਐ ਲਗਤ ਜਗ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: asatut ni(n)dhaa sun biaapat harakh sog vaiseeaai lagat jag anik prakaar kau ||

en.bdb: Just as one feels happy listening to one's praise and disturbed on listening slander about oneself, so should one acknowledge and think that others would feel the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਲ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਜੈਸੋ ਜੈਸੋ ਕਾਕੋ ਉਤਮ ਕੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਰ ਕਉ ॥੩੯੮॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kul dharam karam jaiso jaiso kaako utam kai maan jaan braham birathaar kau ||398||

en.bdb: Similarly, whatever is the business or profession of a person according to his family tradition, it should be accepted as supreme and most appropriate for him. (No one should be hurt on this account). This is enough to understand the Omnipresence of the Lord.  (398)
